finding.message: The session token expiry check was dropped, so an expired token is accepted as valid.
finding.failure_scenario: A caller passes a token whose expiry has elapsed; validate_session returns true and the request proceeds with a stale identity.
finding.evidence_snippet: let validate_session token = Hashtbl.mem sessions token.id
finding.why_now: This PR removed the `not (expired token)` guard from validate_session, so the new call path no longer rejects expired tokens.
finding.suggested_fix: let validate_session token = Hashtbl.mem sessions token.id && not (expired token)

results.evidence_notes: Confirmed: the expiry guard is absent from the changed validate_session and no caller re-checks expiry.
